rules.description: Verify MaxDate is within allowable publication lag for rolling annual series (CURRENT_YEAR - 4) and at least 2020 for quinquennial Population Census series, and values are non-negative (and within [0, 100] for rates) across all 101 indicators

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinValue, MaxValue, NumPlaces, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats
params.condition: CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) >= (CASE WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^(Count_(Student|Teacher|Death|MortalityEvent|Person_(Employed|Unemployed|NotInLaborForce))|UnemploymentRate_Person)') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 4 ELSE 2020 END) AND total_svs >= 101 AND NumPlaces >= 1 AND MinValue >= 0 AND (StatVar != 'UnemploymentRate_Person' OR MaxValue <= 100)

rules.description: Ensure all 84 Population Census indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure annual Labor Force Survey indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure School Basic Survey teacher indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure School Basic Survey student enrollment indicators share a consistent MaxDate
Ensure Vital Statistics total death and cause-of-death indicators share a consistent MaxDate
